properties.name: praxis.openapi.application-group.enabled
properties.description: Controls whether PraxisMetadataAutoConfiguration registers the default catch-all 'application' GroupedOpenApi bean covering all paths except '/schemas/**' and '/praxis/cockpit/**'. Set to false on large multi-group hosts to avoid redundant full-application OpenAPI document capture and indexing; when false, '/schemas/catalog' requires explicit 'group' or 'path' unless a custom 'application' GroupedOpenApi bean is registered.

properties.name: praxis.openapi.prewarm.enabled
properties.description: Enables asynchronous background warming of published OpenAPI group documents after ApplicationReadyEvent. In headless/background threads without an HTTP request context, configure 'app.openapi.internal-base-url'.

properties.name: praxis.openapi.http.connect-timeout
properties.description: Connect timeout used by internal Metadata HTTP lookups to local SpringDoc OpenAPI endpoints.

properties.name: praxis.openapi.http.read-timeout
properties.description: Read timeout used by internal Metadata HTTP lookups to local SpringDoc OpenAPI endpoints.

properties.name: praxis.openapi.bulk-composition-timeout
properties.description: Admission deadline budget for governed OpenAPI preparation, lock acquisition, and bulk lifecycle composition.

properties.name: praxis.bulk.lifecycle.enabled
properties.description: Controls whether BulkOperationLifecycleAutoConfiguration activates governed bulk publication lifecycle enforcement.

properties.name: praxis.bulk.lifecycle.auto-ready-on-startup
properties.description: Opt-in startup initializer that publishes or reconciles every configured bulk confirmation operation onto READY after ContextRefreshedEvent.

properties.name: praxis.bulk.lifecycle.openapi-guard-mode
properties.description: Controls blast radius of governed bulk OpenAPI publication guards: GLOBAL_STRICT fails closed with 503 on all /v3/api-docs and /schemas/filtered reads while suspended/republishing; BULK_SCOPED keeps non-bulk documentary and schema reads serving via ordinary local cache while keeping bulk discovery, readiness, admission, and execution strictly fail-closed.

properties.name: praxis.bulk.lifecycle.startup-convergence
properties.description: Asynchronous startup bulk publication convergence mode submitted after ApplicationReadyEvent (NONE, RECONCILE_ALL, or CONVERGE_ALL). CONVERGE_ALL performs a single cold OpenAPI composition and atomically reconciles matching releases or suspends and republishes drifted releases.

properties.name: praxis.openapi.validation.api-resource-required
properties.description: Validation mode enforced by DynamicSwaggerConfig at startup for controllers extending AbstractResourceQueryController or AbstractCollectionCommandResourceController without @ApiResource.

properties.name: praxis.domain-catalog.cache.max-entries
properties.description: Maximum number of compiled semantic domain catalog entries retained in memory by SemanticDomainCatalogService (LRU eviction).

properties.name: praxis.query.by-ids.max
properties.description: Maximum number of identifiers accepted per request by GET /{resource}/by-ids and options/by-ids endpoints.

properties.name: praxis.pagination.max-size
properties.description: Maximum page size allowed by paginated query endpoints (/filter, /filter/cursor, /locate, /options/filter).

properties.name: praxis.catalog.exclude-paths
properties.description: Comma-separated list of endpoint paths excluded from GET /schemas/catalog summaries.

properties.name: app.openapi.internal-base-url
properties.description: Explicit base URL (for example http://localhost:4003) used by server-side OpenAPI document lookups when running behind proxies/containers or during asynchronous prewarm outside a Servlet request thread.
